findings.title: Dry-run guardrail check uses old project on cross-project move
findings.problem: _run_pre_persist_update_validation passes entity_project_name=workflow.project (the stored/old project) to GuardrailService.sync_guardrail_assignments_for_entity with dry_run=True. When request.project differs from workflow.project, the pre-persist check tests guardrail permissions against the old project context while workflow_service.update_workflow at line 479 and the real sync at lines 481-486 both execute against the new project (updated_workflow.project).
findings.impact: A guardrail assignment that violates the new project's policy can pass the dry-run (old project permits it) and reach the DB commit before enforcement against the new project fires — the scenario the task was explicitly introduced to prevent. Conversely, a valid assignment for the new project is incorrectly rejected during dry-run because the old project is checked, blocking legitimate cross-project moves.
findings.recommendation: Change entity_project_name=workflow.project to entity_project_name=proposed.project if proposed.project else workflow.project on line 114 of _run_pre_persist_update_validation, so the dry-run validates the same project context that will be written to the DB.
